newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-CRA Managed Care upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-CRA Managed Care upgraded.

text.p: --Dain Bosworth Inc said Thursday it upgraded its rating on CRA Managed Care Inc to buy from hold on price.
--A shakeout in the workers compensation sector has made CRA Managed Care shares cheap, Dain analyst J. Chris Sergeant noted in a report.
--The analyst's 12-to-18-month price target for the stock is $54.
--Dain's EPS estimate on the company is $1.52 in 1997 and $1.89 in 1998.
--CRA Managed Care ended trade off 1-1/4 at 41-1/4.
